Comprehensive upstream sync, concurrency controls, timeouts, signing checks, and artifact validation
concerns_zh: 同步流程直接重置并合并主分支，同时删除其他上游工作流，维护边界较激进
签名密码以明文写入 Gradle 属性，GitHub Actions 表达式内插也扩大了脚本注入面
concerns_en: The sync job directly resets and merges the main branch while deleting other upstream workflows, creating an aggressive maintenance boundary
Signing passwords are written in plaintext to Gradle properties, and interpolated GitHub Actions expressions increase script-injection exposure

projects.name: DenchClaw
projects.description: Migrate to dench.com if you're reading this. Fully Managed OpenClaw Framework for all knowledge work ever. CRM Automation and Outreach agents. The only local productivity tool you need.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化较完整的 TypeScript 本地 AI CRM 框架 | 具备持续交付与插件扩展能力
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered TypeScript local AI CRM framework with continuous delivery and plugin extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人与小团队本地部署，规模化前需补强跨平台验证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for local personal and small-team deployment; validate cross-platform behavior before scaling
highlights_zh: 采用类型感知 lint、严格规则和分层测试脚本，基础工程质量较高
提供 CI 发布、版本幂等检查、DuckDB 构建及 npm 安装冒烟验证
支持插件构建、OpenClaw peer dependency 与独立扩展目录，扩展路径清晰
highlights_en: Uses type-aware linting, strict rules, and layered test scripts
Provides CI publishing, idempotent version checks, DuckDB builds, and npm smoke validation
Supports plugin builds, an OpenClaw peer dependency, and clearly separated extension directories
concerns_zh: pnpm-lock.yaml 被忽略且发布流程使用非冻结锁文件安装，削弱依赖可复现性
部署链路依赖 Bash 和 Unix 权限模型，Windows 原生环境支持证据不足
部分应用目录被格式化和 lint 检查排除，可能产生代码规范盲区
concerns_en: The pnpm lockfile is ignored and release installation is non-frozen, weakening dependency reproducibility
Deployment relies on Bash and Unix permission models, with limited evidence of native Windows support
Some application directories are excluded from formatting and lint checks, creating potential quality blind spots

projects.name: poco-claw
projects.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多渠道智能体平台 | 扩展能力突出，质量基线良好
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-channel agent platform with strong extensibility and solid quality fundamentals
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管生产部署，建议补充测试与依赖治理
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted production use; add stronger tests and dependency governance
highlights_zh: CI覆盖Ruff、Pyrefly、ESLint与Prettier，并按后端、执行器等服务并行检查
支持MCP、Skills、预设及多渠道集成，具备清晰的扩展路径
highlights_en: CI covers Ruff, Pyrefly, ESLint, and Prettier across independently checked services
MCP, Skills, presets, and multi-channel integrations provide clear extension paths
concerns_zh: 当前样本未展示单元、集成及端到端测试，健壮性缺少直接验证
根项目依赖列表为空且Python版本要求偏新，依赖治理与部署兼容性需进一步核查
concerns_en: The sample shows no unit, integration, or end-to-end tests, leaving robustness unverified
The root dependency list is empty and Python 3.12+ is required, warranting dependency and compatibility review

projects.name: swarmvault
projects.description: The local-first LLM Wiki: open-source knowledge graph builder, RAG knowledge base, and agent memory store. Built on Andrej Karpathy's pattern. An Obsidian alternative for personal knowledge management, AI second brain, and durable Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw memory.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化完备的本地优先知识图谱工具 | 可持续性仍受团队规模限制
projects.summary_en: Well-engineered local-first knowledge graph toolkit with a sustainability constraint
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人与团队试用，生产采用需审查核心实现
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; review core implementation before production adoption
highlights_zh: pnpm monorepo 配合 TypeScript、Biome、类型检查及分层测试
提供 CI、性能预算、发布预检、浏览器与多模型实时冒烟测试
highlights_en: A typed pnpm monorepo with Biome, type checking, and layered tests
CI includes performance budgets, release preflight, browser checks, and multi-provider smoke tests
concerns_zh: 源码样本未包含核心实现，无法验证模块边界、错误处理与安全控制
仅显示两名贡献者，核心维护的连续性存在风险
concerns_en: Core implementation is absent from the sample, preventing verification of boundaries, error handling, and security controls
Only two contributors are reported, creating continuity risk for core maintenance

projects.name: swarmclaw
projects.description: Open-source self-hosted AI agent runtime and multi-agent framework for autonomous agent swarms. Agent memory, MCP tools, schedules, delegation, and 23+ LLM providers (Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama). A practical Claude Code and LangChain alternative.
projects.summary_zh: 面向自托管场景的多智能体运行时 | 工程化完善但存在技术债务
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered multi-agent runtime for self-hosting, with notable technical debt
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管团队，生产部署前需治理类型债务
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted teams; resolve type-safety debt before production adoption
highlights_zh: 提供单元、运行时、回归、MCP一致性及类型检查测试，并纳入CI门禁
支持多模型提供商、MCP、委派与连接器，具备良好的扩展基础
highlights_en: Comprehensive unit, runtime, regression, MCP conformance, and type checks are enforced in CI
Extensible foundation spanning multiple LLM providers, MCP, delegation, and connectors
concerns_zh: ESLint基线记录352个问题，包含显式any、未使用变量及CommonJS导入等类型债务
发布与桌面构建流程较复杂，Node原生依赖和多平台Electron构建增加维护成本
concerns_en: The ESLint baseline contains 352 issues, including explicit any, unused variables, and CommonJS imports
Complex release and desktop pipelines plus native Node dependencies increase maintenance overhead

projects.name: oli
projects.description: A simple, fast terminal based AI coding assistant
projects.summary_zh: 多提供商智能编码助手 | 工程化基线良好但仍处早期
projects.summary_en: Multi-provider coding assistant with solid engineering foundations but early-stage maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合早期试用，暂不建议用于关键生产环境
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for early trials, but not yet recommended for critical production workloads
highlights_zh: 支持Anthropic、OpenAI、Gemini及Ollama，工具调用抽象具备扩展潜力
Rust与TypeScript分层清晰，CI覆盖格式、Clippy、构建、测试及覆盖率
highlights_en: Supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama with an extensible tool-calling architecture
Clear Rust and TypeScript separation, with CI covering formatting, Clippy, builds, tests, and coverage
concerns_zh: README明确声明项目处于早期阶段，前端测试脚本仍为空
Node.js要求不低于23.10，安装门槛较高；本地Ollama模式也受外部服务可用性限制
CI的路径过滤引用code_checks.yml，而实际工作流名为ci.yml，可能导致部分变更漏检
concerns_en: The README explicitly describes the project as early-stage, and the frontend test script is still unimplemented
Requiring Node.js 23.10 or newer raises the installation barrier, while local Ollama operation depends on an external service
CI path filters reference code_checks.yml although the workflow is named ci.yml, potentially allowing relevant changes to bypass checks

projects.name: agav
projects.description: Terminal-native AI coding assistant for real repositories. Inspect code, edit files, run tests, and verify changes from the CLI.
projects.summary_zh: 实验级多模型终端代理 | 工程化较完整
projects.summary_en: Experimental multi-provider terminal agent with solid engineering foundations
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试用，生产引入前强化自动化安全验证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; harden automation validation before production use
highlights_zh: 支持多模型提供商、MCP、技能扩展及细粒度工具权限
具备类型检查、单元测试、二进制构建与多平台安装流程
highlights_en: Supports multiple providers, MCP, skills, and granular tool permissions
Includes type checking, tests, binary builds, and multi-platform installation
concerns_zh: 部分自动化使用脆弱的 grep/sed JSON 提取方式，且存在重复步骤
无沙箱的模型驱动工作流会处理不可信 Issue 内容，需加强隔离和输出校验
项目仍处于实验阶段，Node.js 22.13 以上要求及 Linux x64 CI 依赖会增加采用门槛
concerns_en: Some automations rely on fragile grep/sed JSON extraction and contain duplicate steps
Model-driven workflows without sandboxing process untrusted issue content and need stronger isolation and validation
The experimental status, Node.js 22.13+ requirement, and Linux x64 CI dependency raise adoption barriers

projects.name: opencrabs
projects.description: The all-in-one AI agent. Build mobile apps, frontend, backend, manages files, deep research, schedule tasks and events. Self-improving, self-healing, fully autonomous. TUI, CLI and Daemon. Connect to your favorite channels. Zero Telemetry.
projects.summary_zh: CI与发布治理较完善的Rust智能体 | 适合受控试点
projects.summary_en: A Rust AI agent with disciplined CI and release governance, suitable for controlled pilots
projects.recommendation_zh: 工程基础较强，可试点，暂不建议直接生产
projects.recommendation_en: Strong engineering foundation; pilot it before production adoption
highlights_zh: 发布流程强制校验主分支与CI绿灯，并阻止不完整制品发布
配置与Provider采用注册表结构，依赖锁定且提交Cargo.lock
highlights_en: Release automation gates on main-branch membership and green CI while rejecting incomplete artifacts
Configuration and provider registries support modular growth, with locked dependencies and a committed Cargo.lock
concerns_zh: 核心Rust实现未包含在样本中，模块边界、错误处理与安全性无法充分验证
Cargo声明的最低Rust版本与CI工具链版本不一致，外部二进制下载也缺少校验机制
concerns_en: Core Rust implementation is absent from the sample, preventing full validation of module boundaries, error handling, and security
The declared minimum Rust version differs from the CI toolchain, and downloaded external binaries lack checksum verification

projects.name: codebase-argus
projects.description: Multi-agent codebase review for PRs, CI, and downstream fork syncs.
projects.summary_zh: 生产导向的多代理代码审查工具 | 工程规范清晰但维护集中度偏高
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented multi-agent review tooling with disciplined engineering but high maintainer concentration
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点采用，核心场景接入前需压测验证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for controlled adoption after load-testing core review workflows
highlights_zh: 提供确定性审查、CI诊断、fork同步及多代理仲裁等完整工作流
CI在部署前执行lint、test和build，并采用最小化Pages权限配置
highlights_en: Covers deterministic review, CI diagnosis, fork synchronization, and multi-provider arbitration
Runs lint, tests, and build before deployment with constrained Pages permissions
concerns_zh: 当前样本未包含核心TypeScript实现，无法验证错误处理、并发控制及安全边界
项目仅显示一名贡献者且版本发布较少，核心模块存在维护集中风险
缺少独立typecheck脚本，依赖锁文件与端到端测试也未在样本中体现
concerns_en: Core TypeScript implementation is absent from the sample, limiting verification of error handling, concurrency, and security boundaries
Only one contributor and limited release history indicate maintainer concentration risk
No separate typecheck script is defined, while lockfile and end-to-end test evidence are not shown

projects.name: selfhost-ai
projects.description: One-command installer for a self-hosted AI stack on your own server: n8n, Ollama, Open WebUI, OpenClaw, Dify, Flowise, Supabase, ComfyUI, Qdrant & 30+ tools. Docker Compose, automatic HTTPS via Caddy, built-in monitoring. Free Zapier/Make alternative.
projects.summary_zh: 面向Ubuntu 24.04的生产级一体化AI自托管安装器 | CI与跨平台能力不足
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented Ubuntu AI stack installer with strong integration but limited CI and portability
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合Ubuntu自托管部署，生产采用需补CI与备份演练
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for Ubuntu self-hosting; add CI and backup validation before production adoption
highlights_zh: 模块化安装、更新、诊断与权限修复脚本职责清晰
Profile、密钥生成、Caddy鉴权与健康检查形成完整工程体系
highlights_en: Modular scripts provide clear separation for installation, updates, diagnostics, and permissions
Profiles, secret generation, Caddy authentication, and health checks form a cohesive engineering baseline
concerns_zh: 依赖Ubuntu 24.04、sudo、Bash及Docker，跨平台移植空间有限
项目无CI/CD，30余项外部服务集成的回归保障不足
concerns_en: Reliance on Ubuntu 24.04, sudo, Bash, and Docker substantially limits cross-platform portability
No CI/CD is present, leaving regression coverage weak for an integration of more than 30 external services

projects.name: Awesome-OpenClaw
projects.description: A carefully curated list of awesome OpenClaw resources — not everything, just the best.  Skills · Plugins · MCP · Tools · Deployments · Security · Research · Alternatives。精心策划的 OpenClaw 优质资源大合集 —— 不求大而全，只求真有用。
projects.summary_zh: 规范清晰的高质量 OpenClaw 资源索引 | 自动化保障不足
projects.summary_en: A well-curated OpenClaw resource index with clear standards but limited automation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合作为人工策展导航，不宜直接作为可信安全源
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable as a curated discovery hub, not a trusted security source
highlights_zh: 贡献规范、条目格式、质量门槛及安全报告流程定义清晰
采用 Markdown、Issue 模板与中英双语 SVG，通用且易于扩展
highlights_en: Clearly documented contribution, vetting, formatting, and security-reporting processes
Uses portable Markdown, issue templates, and bilingual SVG assets for broad reuse
concerns_zh: 无 CI/CD、链接检查或自动格式校验，失效链接和不合规条目可能长期存在
仅一名贡献者且生态图为硬编码时效数据，内容新鲜度依赖人工维护
concerns_en: No CI/CD, link validation, or automated formatting checks, allowing stale links and noncompliant entries to persist
A single contributor and hard-coded ecosystem metrics leave freshness dependent on manual maintenance

projects.name: continue
projects.description: open-source coding agent
projects.summary_zh: 归档型跨平台 AI 编码代理 | 工程化完善但已停止维护
projects.summary_en: Archived cross-platform AI coding agent with mature engineering but no ongoing maintenance
projects.recommendation_zh: 可作参考实现，不宜作为新项目依赖
projects.recommendation_en: Useful as a reference implementation, but unsuitable as a dependency for new projects
highlights_zh: CI覆盖Linux、Windows、macOS及Node 18至24，并包含lint、冒烟、端到端与API测试
CLI、VS Code和JetBrains多端布局清晰，并支持Markdown Agent扩展
highlights_en: CI covers Linux, Windows, macOS and Node 18-24 with lint, smoke, end-to-end and API tests
Clear multi-client architecture for CLI, VS Code and JetBrains with Markdown-based agent extension support
concerns_zh: 仓库已明确停止维护并设为只读，安全修复、依赖升级和兼容性保障将停止
维护流程存在失活与冗余配置，包括被永久禁用的自动修测试任务及仅触发特殊分支的发布流程
concerns_en: The repository is explicitly read-only and unmaintained, so security fixes, dependency upgrades and compatibility support will stop
Maintenance workflows include stale or redundant configuration, including a permanently disabled test-fixing job and release automation tied to a special branch

projects.name: tmux-file-picker
projects.description: A fuzzy file picker in a tmux popup for selecting files with terminal-based AI coding assistants
projects.summary_zh: 轻量实用的 tmux 文件选择工具 | 适合个人开发环境
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, practical tmux file picker best suited to individual developer workflows
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人开发环境，暂不建议作为团队关键基础设施
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal workflows, but not yet recommended as critical team infrastructure
highlights_zh: 启用严格 Shell 模式，参数、依赖、目录及冲突选项均有显式校验
支持 git 根目录、zoxide、目录选择及可配置 fd 参数，功能边界清晰
highlights_en: Uses strict shell mode and explicitly validates arguments, dependencies, directories, and conflicting options
Clearly supports Git roots, zoxide, directory selection, and configurable fd flags
concerns_zh: 项目无 CI/CD、发布记录且仅一名贡献者，缺少自动化回归保障
依赖 Bash、tmux、pgrep、realpath 等平台工具，并存在 macOS/Linux 兼容分支
实现集中于单个 Shell 脚本，代理模式识别与命令拼接会增加维护和注入风险
concerns_en: No CI/CD or release history and only one contributor leave the project without automated regression coverage
Reliance on Bash, tmux, pgrep, realpath, and related platform tools introduces portability constraints
The centralized Shell implementation increases maintenance risk around agent detection and assembled commands

projects.name: Clawlet
projects.description: 🌸 A lightweight AI agent framework with identity awareness inspired by OpenClaw, aimed to be very simple to set up and easy to use, get up and running in 2 minutes.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量本地优先的模块化 AI 智能体框架 | 扩展性较强但仍处 Alpha 阶段
projects.summary_en: Lightweight local-first AI agent framework with strong extensibility, still at alpha maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合原型验证，生产使用需强化测试与维护
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for prototyping; strengthen testing and maintenance before production use
highlights_zh: 采用任务画像、工具集和提供商分层注册机制，扩展路径清晰
具备 uv 锁定依赖、CI 冒烟测试、回归测试及完整部署文档
highlights_en: Clear extension model through task profiles, toolsets, and provider registries
Uses uv lockfile, CI smoke and regression tests, plus comprehensive deployment documentation
concerns_zh: 项目仍为 Alpha 版本，发布次数少且仅有单一贡献者，团队维护风险较高
覆盖率仅报告而不设阻断阈值，缺少可验证的质量门禁
核心 Python 实现未包含在审计样本中，无法验证异常处理、并发安全与安全边界
concerns_en: The project remains alpha with one release and a single contributor, creating maintainer concentration risk
Coverage is report-only without an enforced threshold, leaving the quality gate non-blocking
Core Python implementation was not included in the audit sample, limiting verification of error handling, concurrency safety, and security boundaries

projects.name: openclaw-multitenant
projects.description: Multi-tenant platform layer for OpenClaw. Container isolation, encrypted vault, team sharing. 🦞
projects.summary_zh: 生产导向的多租户平台层 | CI与容器安全基线较完整
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented multi-tenant platform layer with solid CI and container hardening
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合PoC，生产前需验证租户隔离与密钥实现
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for PoC; validate tenant isolation and vault implementation before production
highlights_zh: CI按变更范围分流并采用失败安全策略，配合制品复用提升交付效率
容器采用非root运行并配置健康检查，多阶段依赖安装与固定锁文件增强可复现性
highlights_en: CI uses change-based job scoping, fail-safe defaults, and reusable build artifacts
Containers run as non-root with health checks, while lockfiles support reproducible builds
concerns_zh: 源码样本主要展示上游OpenClaw工程，缺少多租户核心服务及加密保险库实现，README中的安全承诺无法核验
项目无正式发布版本，且构建依赖Bun、pnpm、bash及Node 22等多项环境约束
CI中的自动合并仅覆盖部分补丁依赖，仍需依赖测试与发布审计保障供应链安全
concerns_en: The sample mainly shows the upstream OpenClaw codebase and omits core multi-tenant and vault implementations, leaving README security claims unverified
The project has no formal releases and depends on Bun, pnpm, Bash, Node 22, and other environment-specific tooling
Auto-merge covers only a subset of patch dependencies and still requires testing and release audits for supply-chain assurance

projects.name: openzca
projects.description: Free to use alternative zcacli for integrate Zalo with OpenClaw
projects.summary_zh: 功能完整且兼容性强的 Zalo CLI，适合作为 OpenClaw 集成后端，但需治理单文件膨胀与交付风险
projects.summary_en: A feature-rich, compatibility-focused Zalo CLI suitable as an OpenClaw backend, with monolith and delivery risks to address
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合集成使用，生产部署前应补齐CI并拆分核心
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for integration; add CI and decompose the core before production use
highlights_zh: TypeScript模块化覆盖认证、消息、媒体、文本样式与SQLite等核心能力
提供测试、类型检查、监听重连、媒体降级及插件兼容接口
highlights_en: TypeScript modules cover authentication, messaging, media, text styling, and SQLite
Includes tests, type checking, listener reconnection, media fallback, and plugin-compatible interfaces
concerns_zh: 约5400行的src/cli.ts集中大量命令与处理逻辑，维护和回归风险较高
项目仅一名贡献者且无CI/CD，持续交付、构建验证和长期维护存在集中风险
concerns_en: The roughly 5,400-line src/cli.ts centralizes commands and handlers, increasing maintenance and regression risk
A single contributor and no CI/CD create concentration risk in validation and long-term maintenance

projects.name: claude-code.nvim
projects.description: Seamless integration between Claude Code AI assistant and Neovim
projects.summary_zh: 模块化 Neovim AI 集成插件 | CI 与文档驱动
projects.summary_en: Modular Neovim AI integration with CI and documentation discipline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合日常使用，建议补齐跨平台与故障测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for daily use; add cross-platform and failure-path testing
highlights_zh: 提供44项测试、配置校验、LuaCATS类型标注及Luacheck静态检查
配置覆盖窗口布局、文件刷新、命令参数等场景，扩展接口较丰富
highlights_en: Includes 44 tests, configuration validation, LuaCATS annotations, and Luacheck checks
Extensible configuration covers window layouts, file refresh, and command arguments
concerns_zh: 样本未包含核心Lua实现，无法验证终端状态清理、异步竞态及异常处理质量
CI仅覆盖Ubuntu且工作流混用Actions v3与v4，依赖获取也缺少版本锁定
